title: ComboBox popup and typing
scenario: A ComboBox with 500 items, open with 60 hover moves and closed with 20 typed characters; plus a 100-item popup in which every row fits. Embedded host (popup drawn into the view). Proves G3, G11.
drawCalls: counted per step by the counting COM wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: nothing changes: the first frames lay out both ComboBoxes

phases.name: open
phases.description: focus the 500-item ComboBox and press F4: its popup opens

phases.name: hover
phases.description: the pointer moves to the centre of popup row (step mod 8)

phases.name: type
phases.description: one character typed into the closed editable ComboBox (popup does not auto-open)

phases.name: fit-open
phases.description: focus the 100-item ComboBox and press F4: its popup opens with every row visible

phases.name: fit-hover
phases.description: the pointer moves to the centre of popup row 5 x step
